themes.description: Users consistently report that customer support is unresponsive, unhelpful, and sometimes non-existent, leading to frustration over unresolved issues and delays in refunds or withdrawals.
themes.business_impact: The lack of reliable support causes immediate financial loss for customers, erodes trust, and drives negative reviews that deter potential new users from adopting the app.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The support team is understaffed, lacks clear escalation protocols, and may not have sufficient training or access to system data, resulting in repeated failures to address user concerns.
themes.action_plan:
• Increase support staffing and provide specialized training
• Implement a structured escalation workflow with defined SLAs
• Integrate real‑time ticket visibility into the backend for quicker resolution
• Deploy automated status updates to keep customers informed
• Regularly audit support interactions for quality compliance
